Montreal Communique 


Members of the Alouette football squad will parti- 
cipate in a fitness-testing clinic, to be held during 
an open house in NDG-YMCAts newly modernized fitness 
complex at 4335 Hampton Avenue. 


News media will have an opportunity for preview 
tours of the facility either before or after a special 
press luncheon, scheduled for 1:00 p.m, The public 
is invited from 6:30-10:30, 

The open house is part of a nation-wide drive, 
initiated by the YMCA, to reverse the trend towards 
physical unfitness in Canada, 


As part of the campaign, the Y has developed a 
new range of programs to promote the physical develop- 
ment of youngsters, maintain and strengthen the func-" 
tional‘ capacity of adults and, perhaps of most impor- 
tance to those over 30, to minimize the risks of heart 
attack, 


For further information call: Bill Sher 849-5331 
Doug Barnes 486-7315
